about: Animation data for fights (CONTRACT-PHASE4.md §9.9, COMBAT.md §14): 16 pose specs for each of the six stray archetypes (96), one flourish per shadow genre (two hand frames and a procedural effect), effect primitives with their parameters (a two-number array runs from the first to the second across the frames), the effect each spell plays, and the stray pose each clip plays. Pose ops are closed: swapLegs, squash, stretch, shift, lift, flash, dither. Timing of beats lives in rules.json; fps here is the clip frame rate (8–12).
